basic_info.description: A rarely available premier, corner south facing condo, featuring 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms at St. Paul's Common. This beautiful home seamlessly blends modern, fresh updated kitchen and baths with the timeless charm of a historic building. The oversized classroom windows flood the space with southern and western light all day long.  The open living and dining floor plan is perfect for entertaining, while high ceilings amplify the sense of space. Convenience is key with an in-unit washer and dryer and included one-car garage parking with interior access to the secure lobby. There is an elevator and sunny shared gardens. You'll be captivated by the serenity of this sunny residence, ideally positioned to take advantage of all that Noe Valley has to offer. No hills to access in half a block  numerous local conveniences, restaurants, shops, Muni, tech shuttles, and freeway routes. The building is professionally managed for ease of ownership.
